description: Metadata pointer from a file row to its binary payload in internal CAS storage.

columns.name: blob_hash
columns.description: BLAKE3 content hash used as the canonical CAS key for the binary payload.

columns.name: id
columns.description: File primary-key value (matches lix_file.id) for this binary reference row.

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: Logical uncompressed file size in bytes for the referenced binary payload.
